scope: Real GPU fixture for paired raw and reconstructed presentation; separate actual-scene checks retain their existing thresholds.
checks: Raw presentation matches independent filmic/sRGB calculation from actual private GPU accumulation read back through a blit.
Trace sample count and random-seed increments equal exactly the requested SPP.
Each changed scene time causes only one traffic update.
Paused scene time and geometry remain unchanged during capture.
Both outputs are byte-identical when reconstruction is disabled.
The original single-output preview API retains its requested sample budget.

diagnostics.selectedCaseCommand: <temporary copied app>/Contents/MacOS/ArchitectureEngine --location chicago --motion-test <distinct trial directory> --motion-case willis-night --width 960 --height 600 --samples 8 --frames 32 --reference-samples 128
diagnostics.input: Same copied release executable, Renderer.metal, geometry and packaged map data. Only copied Denoise.metal varied in the temporary diagnostic app; production shader remained unchanged.

trialChanges.temporal-only: Spatial blend strength set to zero.
trialChanges.night-scale: Only night spatial absolute luminance tolerance changed from 0.03 to 0.0005.
trialChanges.emitter-temporal: Original spatial filter; added a 3x3 emissive-neighbor current-history bypass at night.

diagnostics.reasonDiscarded: Opposing results in repeated equal-setting trials prevented acceptance of a marginal filter tweak. The old raw/reconstructed streams were independently traced through separate acceleration structures. The benchmark now captures both presentations from one actual accumulation. Exact origin of all cross-process differences was not established.
diagnostics.baselineModeCaveat: The preserved baseline was the full five-case Chicago sequence, whereas the diagnostic runs selected Willis-night only. Seed reset does not erase differing prior AS refit histories. These are diagnostic records, not claims of paired filter improvement.
